title: Johncraft
intro: St John's College, rebuilt from OpenStreetMap at one block per two metres. The courts are solid stone because nobody mapped the insides. The creepers did not read the listed building consent.
noLock: Your browser will not lock the mouse. Hold a button and drag to look.
respawn: Click to respawn at the SBR
sbrSign: Samuel Butler Room - I2, First Court
sbrSign2: TV with a Wii, pool table, piano, board games
welcome: You spawn outside the SBR, I2 First Court. The Wii is inside. You cannot get inside.
Hint: creepers have no respect for Grade I listed buildings.
facts: The Samuel Butler Room was founded in 1960, for St John's postgraduates.
The SBR room is in the corner of First Court: TV with a Wii, board games, a pool table, a piano and a small kitchen.
Samuel Butler studied at St John's from 1854 to 1858. He would have hated creepers.
BA Table is on Tuesdays and Fridays in term. Port & Sherry follows on Fridays, GBP1.50.
The Graduate Study Room (GSR) is at 1 All Saints Passage.
The Bridge of Sighs was built in 1831 by Henry Hutchinson. It is not blast rated.
Your University Card opens both the SBR and the postgraduate study room.
The SBR address: The Samuel Butler Room, St John's College, CB2 1TP.
